## HN discussion (2 comments)

- [other] BElluu: I do not know why, but it's so laggy on my PC in chrome. When I cut some ink or do some chaotic moves it's more than 1000ms Presentation delay
- [author] georgestrakhov: yes, definitely some optimizations are due if you go beyond 20-30 moves or move fast. would love a PR on that if anyone cares!

{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个创意十足的小型浏览器产品：把日本墨流纸（Suminagashi）做成可交互的绘制工具，包含墨色、工具、滴墨、打印等具体功能。它属于有趣的小众艺术作品，而非底层技术组件。评论提到卡顿，但这只是性能问题，不影响它作为创意产品值得一看。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's claims are supported by the accessibility tree and comments: it describes an interactive Suminagashi tool with ink colors, tools, Dip, and Print, and a commenter reports lag. It names concrete features and argues for push, treating the lag as a minor performance issue.
